rationale: Section 22 is the only audit/verification right binding us as Customer, and it meets or exceeds every element of the preferred position: frequency capped at once in any twelve-month period (22.1); thirty days' prior written notice (22.1); normal business hours with no unreasonable disruption (22.1); off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1); Vendor bears audit costs unless the audit establishes underpayment exceeding five percent, and then only reasonable costs plus the undisputed shortfall (22.2); and an express bar on Vendor or its auditor accessing Customer systems directly, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information (22.2).
